entries.brief: Original SKAZ D&D2014 fantasy reference-book spell illustration. Mature painterly realism, restrained natural colors, strong compact silhouette readable at32px on both dark navy and cream backgrounds, generous transparent margins. Single centered motif, no text, no UI, no border, no cartoon, no noisy scene. Move Earth: cross-section of soft brown earth shaped into a smooth raised terrace and broad trench, intact grass tuft moved with soil. One small iron spade at edge. Slow deliberate shaping, no exploding rocks, no stone manipulation.
